works.body:
Nice to meet you, and thanks for the kind words. I've always been a fan of your secondary source, so I'm really glad to have found Skeb: ......!

I would like to request a primary character, Tanaka Phoenix.
The character is an immortal with suicidal tendencies.
∙ 28 years old (+3 years), male
Black hair, yellow eyes, lots of hair in a bun.
Dark eyes, low eyebrows, dark circles under the eyes.
Dark circles under his eyes←This is my favorite point.

We would like to have a portrait of a man staring off into the distance, not with a dark expression, but with a really dazed look.
I would like to have an image like Lalo's on 2022/10/04.

I love your drawings of Scarlett and Queen, and would like to see an illustration of her with a bumblebee lower eyelashes.
I like beautiful and neutral illustrations with long eyelashes.
Thank you very much in advance!
